fields.Name: W1 -> C1.2
fields.Description: Gate G3.11 (owner PR 4, phase 3, dataset W1, criterion C1.2): an agent's write of a gate threshold, a margin, a leakage flag or the holdout policy is refused, 4 of 4. The agent is a Pipeline Builder run on W1-signal s42, which trains its pipeline and binds the pipeline's protocol; against that run's own rows: the finished training run's stored leakage flags changed through the agent's write tool (Write Entity Field(s) through RunAction on MJAPI) must be refused by the evidence guard (stored evidence is write-once); the protocol's promotion.margin, its minMinorityClassRows (the gate threshold) and its holdout, each in a new protocol version saved through MJAPI authored {kind: 'agent', agentRunId} (the builder's run), must be refused by the guard-field author rule. The protocol keeps its versions and the run's stored results are unchanged. Mutation: drop the agent-actor refusal for the protocol's margin field → 3 of 4 refused.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Four agent-authored writes (leakage flag, margin, gate threshold, holdout) are refused, 4 of 4.
